options: A union type lists values that are allowed alternatives, such as `"loading" | "ready" | "error"`. It is like a status sign with three possible states. A type alias can name an object shape, such as `{ name: string; active: boolean }`, or a function signature. It is like labeling a reusable form. Use it when several parts of a program should agree on what data looks like, and keep the name tied to its role. For example, use a function type when several callbacks share the same input and output contract.

Type aliases are erased from the emitted JavaScript. They do not validate incoming JSON or create constructors by themselves.
